description: This file declares network-related functions and structures for the lighttpd server, including socket management and initialization routines.

methods.name: network_accept_tcp_nagle_disable
methods.description: Disables Nagle's algorithm on a TCP socket to improve latency.

methods.name: network_init
methods.description: Initializes network components for the server.

methods.name: network_close
methods.description: Closes network connections and cleans up resources.

methods.name: network_register_fdevents
methods.description: Registers network file descriptors for event-driven I/O.

methods.name: network_unregister_sock
methods.description: Unregisters a server socket from event monitoring.

methods.name: network_socket_activation_to_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables for socket activation.
